in_marathi.name: Charvik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Shiva's power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charvik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charvik is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Char' meaning 'foremost' and 'Vik' meaning 'power'. This name is believed to represent the immense power of Lord Shiva. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is the supreme god who embodies both creation and destruction.
